notes: Resident script bank only. The Working Authority loads further banks from disk and their text is not covered.
36 distinct records back the 64 system string slots; repeated pointers are unused slots sharing a target, not separate messages.
191 inline messages belong to the 64 entry-table scripts and 15 to entries outside that table.
Records are stored verbatim, padding included: the pool centres each line within its field and that alignment is a presentation fact (#307), not decoration.
0 of 14 indexed message references resolve through the $7A42 table rather than straight into the slot table, and carry no target rather than a guessed one.
4 slots point at the pool terminator and resolve to an empty record; that is what the table holds, not a failed read.

encoding.note: Records are NUL-terminated printable ASCII; the decode fails closed outside $20-$7E. Every byte of every record in this bank falls in $20-$5A: no lowercase, no control code, no escape and no formatting marker appears in either form.
